continuity: The Black Tiger is an ancient guardian spirit born alongside the sacred stone that sustains the hidden land beneath Ailao Mountain, formerly the Sacred Land.
The Beast King Stone was a legend created by Nanman's first Palace Lord from a powerless stone; the actual sacred stone's ability to rule beasts is only one of its powers.
Human wars depleted the sacred stone's power, and the Black Tiger now regrets observing the first Palace Lord's death instead of saving him.
The Black Tiger offers the Water God Dragon's Origin Essence to restore the sacred stone and correct its past choice.
The System has revealed the Hidden Sacred Land and created the hidden Quest Last Chance.
Jin has not yet decided whether to strengthen the Ancient Sacred Stone with the Water God Dragon's Origin Essence.
Yohi and Muyaho remain near the healing pond and have witnessed the realm-wide tremor and pillar of light.
plot: The Black Tiger reveals the enormous cracked boulder at the summit as the sacred stone, the true source behind the legendary Beast King Stone. The first Palace Lord never owned it; he created a powerless stone bearing its name to unite Nanman's tribes and end their war. The sacred stone once sustained the land's abundance, but centuries of human violence drained its power. The Black Tiger admits it watched without intervening and has regretted for two hundred years failing to save the first Palace Lord.

The Black Tiger asks Jin for a chance to restore the sacred stone with the Water God Dragon's Origin Essence. The System renames the Apparition of Ailao Mountain as a guardian spirit, reveals the Hidden Sacred Land, creates the hidden Quest Last Chance, and asks whether Jin will use the Origin Essence to strengthen the Ancient Sacred Stone. Meanwhile, Yohi and Muyaho witness the realm shake as birds and beasts rise and a pillar of light envelops the unknown space.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung, Yohi, and Muyaho remain in the hidden healing realm deep within the Poisonblood Grounds.
The healing pond saved Muyaho from the brink of death and restored Jin's severe injuries.
The Black Tiger is an ancient guardian spirit born alongside the sacred stone and protects the hidden land beneath Ailao Mountain, formerly the Sacred Land.
The sacred stone sustains the land's abundance, and its power to rule beasts is only one of its abilities.
The Beast King Stone was a powerless stone created by Nanman's first Palace Lord as a legend to unite the tribes; the actual sacred stone was never his possession.
Human wars drained the sacred stone's power, while the Black Tiger watched without intervening and later regretted failing to save the first Palace Lord.
The Black Tiger possesses the Water God Dragon's Origin Essence and wants to use it to restore the sacred stone.
The System changed the Black Tiger's designation to guardian spirit, revealed the Hidden Sacred Land, and created the hidden Quest Last Chance.
Jin must decide whether to strengthen the Ancient Sacred Stone with the Water God Dragon's Origin Essence.
Yohi and Muyaho witnessed a tremor, the awakening of birds and beasts, and a pillar of light enveloping the hidden realm.
Jin still intends to find an exit and return to Nanman before the Southern Heaven Demon Empress's attack causes further deaths.
The System's unidentified discovery remains unresolved.
